spoken_brief: Good afternoon. 2 things need your attention. ITC reported Q2 FY27 results: revenue up 4 percent year on year, profit after tax down 18 percent. ITC: ITC Limited has approved the amalgamation of its wholly owned subsidiary Sproutlife Foods Private Limited. CDSL moved up 5 percent on 3.2 times its usual volume. Asian Paints moved up 3 percent on 2.2 times its usual volume. 3 routine filings are hidden.
